data.content_ref: inline:Expose the suspension boundary as a first-class diagnostic artifact: for each UNDECIDED node, record its full attacker set and the maximal defense chains that failed to reinstate it. This is a pure read-only projection of the final labeling, so determinism of the fixed point, polynomial cost, reinstatement-as-derived, and validity of every committed root are untouched. The strengthening is operational: the boundary atlas, with per-node witness chains, becomes admissible evidence for the next conjecture iteration, so subsequent warrants can attack the symmetry that produced the suspension instead of re-litigating settled nodes. This directly targets the spec's own diagnosis that the whole question lives in edge construction, not in the label computation.
